study: Exploratory calibration-fit sensitivity after observing the initial temperature-scaling results
resampling: Draw calibration and test representatives independently with replacement. Same calibration and test draws across all six models. Refit each temperature on the drawn calibration cases only; evaluate after-minus-before NLL on the drawn test cases.
scope: Empirical percentile sensitivity ranges conditional on frozen models and observed calibration/test pools; no training or patient-cluster uncertainty. No new decision threshold, model selection or external evaluation.
reporting: Per-model temperature distribution and boundary frequency; mean after-minus-before NLL over three seeds per arm, fraction of replicates above zero. Fractions are not posterior probabilities or p-values.
